predecessors.name: Liang Province rebels
predecessors.text: Liang Province of Han Sui and Ma Teng, without Song Jian's Fuhan

successors.name: Cao Cao
successors.text: the Wei valley (Baoji) from 211, then Liang Province: Gansu and Ningxia, without Fuhan, to 215

rulers.name: Han Sui
rulers.title: co-ruler of Liang Province with Ma Teng; General Who Guards the West 192-195, Pacifies the Qiang 195-201, Attacks the West 201-211

rulers.name: Ma Teng
rulers.title: co-ruler of Liang Province; summoned to Ye 208, executed June or July 212

rulers.name: Ma Chao
rulers.title: set over Liang Province by Han Sui after his father's summons

ledger.x: 192: the defeat west of Chang'an ends the attempt; Han Sui is given the title General Who Guards the West and the warlords withdraw to Liang.
211: the warlords rise against Cao Cao, the court's minister.
211: the coalition is broken at Tong Pass; Han Sui and Ma Chao retreat to Liang Province.

wars.name: Liang warlords' march on Chang'an
wars.outcome: Han Sui and Ma Teng, allied with Liu Yan, were defeated 13 miles west of Chang'an and retreated to Liang Province.

wars.name: Battle of Tong Pass
wars.outcome: Cao Cao defeated Ma Chao's coalition in September 211; Han Sui's family was killed; Liang and Yong were lost.

wars.name: Xiahou Yuan's campaign in Liang
wars.outcome: Han Sui, defeated by Xiahou Yuan, died in June or July 215.

certainty.note: No page gives a boundary; the shapes are modern units.
